market.what: Electronic-grade TMAH (photoresist developer) bought by fabs + LCD, world
market.method: avg of reports $0.67B (2024), $1.18B (2025), $1.3B (2024); >250 kt/yr TMAH solution used

value.logic: 30% of ~$1.0B TMAH buy displaced by recovered TMAH = $300M, net of ~40% recovery cost = ~$180M; less toxic TMAH to bio-treatment (not counted)
value.revenue_logic: recovery media spend ~10% of $300M recovered value = $30M x ~40% share; sold to recovery operators (Chang Chun, Organo)

trend.drivers: more litho layers, new fabs (US, JP, TW); TSMC recycling saves 24 kt/yr new TMAH; toxic TMAH effluent limits
trend.deadline: Taiwan science-park TMAH effluent limit 60 ppm (in force)

competition.notes: TSMC + Chang Chun/Sanfu already regenerate e-grade TMAH by electrolysis + filtration (Fab 14B Oct 2024, -24 kt/yr new buy); ion-exchange route known. Room is dilute (<100 ppm) streams. Gradiant raised $225M (2023).

lab.synth: macrocycle/grafted resin: TMA+ host (calixarene/cucurbituril-type) on a support, 2-3 variants
lab.test: batch isotherms + column breakthrough on simulated fab waste (TMA+ vs NH4+, Na+); TMA+ by cation ion chromatography; ASTM D2187 resin capacity; univ. lab
lab.logic: 10-12 wk synth/grafting + 3-4 wk tests; ~$35k synth + ~$10k IC (~$50-100/sample) and columns

sale.gates: pilot at recovery operator 6-12 mo; if reused in fab: SEMI-grade metals/purity + fab PCN qual 1-2 yr
